title: Validity of contracts illegally effectuated.
bodyText: A contract of insurance effectuated by an unauthorized insurer in violation of this article shall be voidable except at the instance of the insurer.
bodyHtml: §431:8-203  Validity of contracts illegally effectuated.  A contract of insurance effectuated by an unauthorized insurer in violation of this article shall be voidable except at the instance of the insurer. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
